gate_1_recording_first.decision: Root may authorize these recording-only checks after preserving exact source, approved private-target compiler result and test plan. Passing this static review does not run or claim these checks.
constraints: Run only named tests, using owned temp directories and supplied recording Git. Remote-constructor calls must refuse before process dispatch. No real Git ref transactions, live hosts, user repository/keys, host PID lookup or signal logic.

Confirm unsupported version/missing acknowledgement prevents dispatch; split-index rotation captures a coherent pair or refuses; prepared veto/HEAD switch/detach/index/work mutation prevents checkout and preserves external bytes; uncertainty keeps directories.

Record exact source/binary/log hashes and test counts, commit/push/verify remote SHA before the next gate. Root assesses recording results before releasing real fixtures. Compiler-only fixes must remain preserved and be rebound to the reviewed production source.

gate_2_owned_temporary_repository_condit.decision: After Gate 1 passes and root accepts its evidence, root may authorize the following bounded, owned temporary-repository fixtures without another broad planning loop. Any production protocol/source change requires static re-review before execution.
containment: Use exclusively newly created owned local temp repositories and private HOME/XDG/Git config with no inherited user repositories, hooks, aliases, credentials, remotes, promisor configuration or live SSH/WSL. Use an explicit recorded Git executable/version/hash; successful repair requires supported Git>=2.50.

Use existing approved bounded owned-child execution only. No new watchdog, host-wide process/PID selector, signal controller, manual lock deletion of other processes, or remote mutation. Create lock fixtures only inside the owned temp repository with exclusive creation and retained ownership.

Preserve fixture source/plan with correct-author commit+push+remote verification before execution. Keep each bounded call below normal runner deadlines and report progress; retain logs and uncertain evidence.
required_cases: Actual scratch capability proof on files/sha1 and each additionally supported backend/format claimed. Validate hook selection, exact stdin/argv and current HEAD symref plus branch transaction. Backend refusal is safe-refusal evidence, not successful repair evidence.

Successful actual production repair: expected branch/HEAD/index/worktree state and mandatory prepared/checkout/committed acknowledgements; original hook receives original args/stdin/config. Exercise special-character paths through quoted boundaries.
Owned held-target-ref-lock fixture: production repair refuses with exact index/worktree bytes and modes and refs unchanged; no automatic rollback or unrelated lock cleanup.

Original prepared veto, attempted HEAD switch/detach, index replacement and tracked working-byte changes: refusal before checkout when possible; exact external edits preserved. Native HEAD-lock enforcement must be established with real Git, not inferred from fake recordings.

Actual split-index pair: rotate live index/dependency at snapshot boundary, resolve from saved before.index using production GIT_INDEX_FILE path, and verify saved dependency/recovery metadata correspond to that saved index. Missing dependency must refuse before user update.

Checkout/later committed-hook failure and bounded timeout: retain actionable before.index, correct dependency, old/new IDs and phase/update evidence. Inspect actual refs and concurrent edits; do not restore automatically or claim an uncommitted transaction when Git already committed.
Unsupported Git/capability/backend and missing-hook acknowledgement refuse before user-ref mutation. Existing old-Git may prove refusal; do not claim success without a supported executable.
gate_2_owned_temporary_repository_condit.acceptance: Record actual before/after ref, HEAD, raw index/dependency and working-file snapshots, child result and retained evidence. Commit/push/verify results before broader feature gates. Failures return to source review; no silent skips or whole-feature PASS.

open_feature_limits: Remote automatic repair remains INTERIM fail-closed and open. A counter/marker is not per-request completion/outcome ownership and does not complete remote mutation support.
No actual backend/Windows success or held-lock/timeout behavior has yet been demonstrated by this static review.
Normal Git filter/normalization semantics and explicit UTF8/index-size/sparse restrictions remain; arbitrary external worktree writers are not globally locked.
Default-port/auth retry/deletion journal/full-feature/combined tests and final independent whole-combination review remain separate. CI is deferred by user instruction.
